race.comment: EMPRESS ROSSA (9) wasn't far away on debut last start over 1100m at Warrnambool, finishing second and beaten 2 lengths. Open to sharp improvement with that under the belt and draws beautifully, so and can get off the mark this time. CINNAMON KISS (8) closed off strongly last start to get up for second, beaten 1.3 lengths, over 1200m at Mt Gambier when resuming after a spell. This is probably a smidgin tougher, but she'll be fitter and Meech on is a plus. MISTER SOLLY (4) comes through the same race as CINNAMON KISS, finishing just behind her, so has form around the right rivals. Just needs to overcome the rough draw. JUST MY LOT (10) is a talented filly who was tested in the Tassie Oaks, so you'd think she's going to be better over further later in the prep but her trials have been sharp enough to suggest she can run a race. OKEAH (5) hasn't done much to date but is with a new stable and has been trialling like an improved run is on the cards.
